findings.description: The wrapper now clears and reuses the single statistics dict shared by all calls to the same decorated function, instead of giving each call its own dict. A nested or concurrent call of the same function overwrites and clears the statistics of the call still in progress.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a @retry-decorated function that calls itself (recursion) or is called concurrently from another thread. The inner call runs stats.clear() on the same dict that the outer call's self._local.statistics points to, so the outer call's attempt_number and other stats are reset or replaced by the inner call's values. Impact: retry statistics read by the caller after or during the call are wrong, which the original copy-per-call design was meant to prevent.
